query: Consider the following context: How to rationally design composition of alloys with desired properties has always been an open and challenging question, especially for high-entropy alloy (HEA) which has huge selections of composition due to the feature of multi-principal elements. Although great efforts have been made in the past decades, such as approaches based on thermo-kinetic analysis and simulations, strategies to quick determine the optimal HEA composition remain lacking. In that context, which method can be used for design intrinsically strong, ductile, and low-weight refractory HEA (RHEA) compositions, and why?

generation.hypothesis: A deep learning-based predictive model can be used to design intrinsically strong, ductile, and low-weight refractory HEA (RHEA) compositions by optimizing the composition of multi-principal elements.
generation.material_initial_state: Multi-principal elements with huge selections of composition
generation.intervention: Deep learning-based predictive model for HEA composition optimization
generation.mechanism: Machine learning algorithms and data analytics to predict optimal composition
generation.predicted_outcome: 20% increase in strength, 15% increase in ductility, and 10% decrease in weight compared to baseline RHEA compositions
generation.boundary: Composition optimization within the constraints of multi-principal elements and refractory properties
generation.uncertainty: Limited by the quality and quantity of training data, and the complexity of the relationships between composition, processing, and properties

falsification_experiment.design: Composition optimization using deep learning-based predictive model, followed by experimental validation of predicted compositions
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the predicted compositions do not show at least 15% increase in strength, 10% increase in ductility, and 5% decrease in weight compared to baseline RHEA compositions, the hypothesis is falsified
